name: CoFE-RAG
description: CoFE-RAG is a comprehensive full-chain evaluation framework designed to assess Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems across the entire pipeline, including chunking, retrieval, reranking, and generation. It introduces multi-granularity keywords to evaluate retrieved context and provides a holistic benchmark dataset covering diverse document formats and query types to enhance data diversity in evaluation.
reputation: A recent RAG evaluation framework that is emerging in the research community, but it is not yet a broadly adopted standard benchmark.
notes: Addresses limitations in data diversity and evaluation stability for RAG systems; evaluates multiple pipeline stages with novel keyword-based retrieval assessment.
